verses.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
verses.modern: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:

verses.kjv: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.modern: Grace and peace to You from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
verses.modern: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, Who has blessed us in the heavenly realms with every spiritual blessing in Christ.

verses.kjv: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
verses.modern: For He chose us in Him before the creation of the world to be holy and blameless in His sight in love.

verses.kjv: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
verses.modern: He predestined us for adoption as His sons through Jesus Christ, in accordance with His pleasure and will—

verses.kjv: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.
verses.modern: to the praise of the glory of His grace, by which He has made us accepted in the beloved.

verses.kjv: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
verses.modern: In Him we have redemption through His blood — the forgiveness of sins — according to the riches of His grace

verses.kjv: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;
verses.modern: that He lavished on us. With all wisdom and understanding,

verses.kjv: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:
verses.modern: He made known to us the mystery of His will according to His good pleasure, which He purposed in Christ,

verses.kjv: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:
verses.modern: to be put into effect when the times reach their fulfillment — to bring all things in heaven and on earth together under one head, even Christ.

verses.kjv: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:
verses.modern: In Him we were also chosen, having been predestined according to the plan of Him who works out everything in conformity with the purpose of His will,

verses.kjv: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.
verses.modern: so that we, who were the first to put our hope in Christ, might be to the praise of His glory.

verses.kjv: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
verses.modern: In Him You also trusted, after You heard the word of truth, the gospel of Your salvation. In Him also, after You believed, You were sealed with that Holy Spirit of promise,

verses.kjv: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
verses.modern: who is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, to the praise of His glory.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,
verses.modern: For this reason, ever since I heard about Your faith in the Lord Jesus and Your love for all the saints,

verses.kjv: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
verses.modern: I have not stopped giving thanks for You, remembering You in my prayers.

verses.kjv: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
verses.modern: I keep asking that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give You the Spirit of wisdom and revelation, so that You may know Him better.

verses.kjv: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
verses.modern: I pray that the eyes of Your heart may be enlightened so that You may know the hope to which He has called You, the riches of His glorious inheritance in the saints,

verses.kjv: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,
verses.modern: and the incomparably great power toward us who believe. That power is like the working of His mighty strength,

verses.kjv: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,
verses.modern: which He exerted when He raised Christ from the dead and seated Him at His right hand in the heavenly realms,

verses.kjv: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
verses.modern: far above all rule and authority, power and dominion, and every name that is invoked — not only in the present age but also in the one to come.

verses.kjv: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,
verses.modern: God placed all things under His feet and appointed Him to be head over everything for the church,

verses.kjv: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.
verses.modern: which is His body — the fullness of Him who fills everything in every way.

chapters.summary: Paul blesses God for choosing believers in Christ before the foundation of the world and predestinating them to the adoption of children according to the good pleasure of His will. He prays that the Ephesians would know the hope of their calling, the riches of God's inheritance in the saints, and the exceeding greatness of His power toward those who believe.

verses.kjv: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
verses.modern: God quickened You — you who were dead in Your transgressions and sins,

verses.kjv: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:
verses.modern: in which in time past you walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.

verses.kjv: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
verses.modern: Among whom we all also had our conduct in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

verses.kjv: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
verses.modern: But because of His great love for us, God, Who is rich in mercy,

verses.kjv: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)
verses.modern: even when we were dead in sins, He quickened us together with Christ — it is by grace You have been saved.

verses.kjv: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:
verses.modern: And God raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,

verses.kjv: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
verses.modern: in order that in the coming ages He might show the incomparable riches of His grace expressed in His kindness to us in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
verses.modern: For it is by grace You have been saved, through faith — and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God—

verses.kjv: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
verses.modern: not by works, so that no one can boast.

verses.kjv: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
verses.modern: For we are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God has before ordained that we should walk in them.

verses.kjv: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
verses.modern: Therefore, remember that formerly You who are Gentiles by birth — called "uncircumcised" by those who call themselves "the circumcision" (which is done in the body by human hands)—

verses.kjv: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
verses.modern: remember that at that time You were separate from Christ, excluded from citizenship in Israel and foreigners to the covenants of the promise, without hope and without God in the world.

verses.kjv: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.
verses.modern: But now in Christ Jesus You who once were far away have been brought near by the blood of Christ.

verses.kjv: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
verses.modern: For He is our peace, who has made both one, and has broken down the middle wall of partition between us,

verses.kjv: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;
verses.modern: by setting aside in His flesh the law with its commands and regulations. His purpose was to create in Himself one new humanity out of the two, thus making peace,

verses.kjv: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:
verses.modern: and in one body to reconcile both of them to God through the cross, by which He put to death their hostility.

verses.kjv: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.
verses.modern: He came and preached peace to You who were far away and peace to those who were near.

verses.kjv: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.
verses.modern: For through Him we both have access to the Father by one Spirit.

verses.kjv: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
verses.modern: Now therefore You are no longer strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,

verses.kjv: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;
verses.modern: built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus Himself as the chief cornerstone.

verses.kjv: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:
verses.modern: In Him the whole building is joined together and rises to become a holy temple in the Lord.

verses.kjv: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.
verses.modern: And in Him You too are being built together to become a dwelling place of God through the Spirit.

chapters.summary: Paul teaches that believers were dead in trespasses and sins but God, who is rich in mercy, quickened them together with Christ — by grace they are saved through faith, and that not of themselves, it is the gift of God, not of works. He declares that Christ has broken down the wall of partition between Jew and Gentile, making of the two one new man in Himself.

verses.kjv: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,
verses.modern: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of You Gentiles—

verses.kjv: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:
verses.modern: Surely You have heard about the administration of God's grace that was given to me for You,

verses.kjv: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,
verses.modern: that is, the mystery made known to me by revelation, as I have already written briefly.

verses.kjv: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)
verses.modern: In reading this, then, You will be able to understand my insight into the mystery of Christ,

verses.kjv: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;
verses.modern: which was not made known to people in other generations as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to God's holy apostles and prophets.

verses.kjv: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:
verses.modern: that the Gentiles should be fellow heirs, of the same body, and partakers of His promise in Christ through the gospel,

verses.kjv: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.
verses.modern: I became a servant of this gospel by the gift of God's grace given me through the working of His power.

verses.kjv: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
verses.modern: Although I am less than the least of all the Lord's people, this grace was given me: to preach to the Gentiles the boundless riches of Christ,

verses.kjv: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:
verses.modern: and to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world has been hidden in God, Who created all things by Jesus Christ,

verses.kjv: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,
verses.modern: His intent was that now, through the church, the manifold wisdom of God should be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms,

verses.kjv: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
verses.modern: according to His eternal purpose that He accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.kjv: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.
verses.modern: In Him and through faith in Him we may approach God with freedom and confidence.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
verses.modern: I ask You, therefore, not to be discouraged because of my sufferings for You, which are Your glory.

verses.kjv: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.modern: For this reason I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.kjv: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
verses.modern: from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.

verses.kjv: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;
verses.modern: I pray that out of His glorious riches He may strengthen You with power through His Spirit in Your inner being,

verses.kjv: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
verses.modern: so that Christ may dwell in Your hearts through faith. And I pray that You, being rooted and established in love,

verses.kjv: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;
verses.modern: may have power, together with all the Lord's people, to grasp how wide and long and high and deep is the love of Christ,

verses.kjv: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
verses.modern: and to know this love that surpasses knowledge — that You may be filled to the measure of all the fullness of God.

verses.kjv: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
verses.modern: Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,

verses.kjv: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.
verses.modern: to Him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

chapters.summary: Paul reveals the mystery hidden from past ages: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs with Israel, members of the same body, and partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus through the gospel. He prays that the Ephesians would be strengthened with might by the Spirit in the inner man and would know the love of Christ which passes knowledge.

verses.kjv: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,
verses.modern: As a prisoner for the Lord, then, I urge You to live a life worthy of the calling You have received.

verses.kjv: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
verses.modern: With complete humility and gentleness, with longsuffering, bearing with one another in love.

verses.kjv: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
verses.modern: Make every effort to keep the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.

verses.kjv: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
verses.modern: There is one body and one Spirit, just as You were called to one hope when You were called—

verses.kjv: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
verses.modern: one Lord, one faith, one baptism—

verses.kjv: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
verses.modern: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.

verses.kjv: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
verses.modern: But to each one of us grace has been given as Christ apportioned it.

verses.kjv: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.
verses.modern: Therefore He says: "When He ascended on high, He led captivity captive, and gave gifts to men."

verses.kjv: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
verses.modern: What does "He ascended" mean except that He also descended to the lower, earthly regions?

verses.kjv: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)
verses.modern: He who descended is the very one who ascended higher than all the heavens, in order to fill the whole universe.

verses.kjv: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
verses.modern: So Christ Himself gave the apostles, the prophets, the evangelists, and the pastors and teachers,

verses.kjv: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:
verses.modern: to equip His people for works of service, so that the body of Christ may be built up

verses.kjv: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:
verses.modern: until we all come to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a perfect man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,

verses.kjv: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
verses.modern: Then we will no longer be infants, tossed back and forth by the waves, and blown here and there by every wind of teaching and by the cunning and craftiness of people in their deceitful scheming.

verses.kjv: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
verses.modern: Instead, speaking the truth in love, we will grow to become in every respect the mature body of Him who is the head, that is, Christ.

verses.kjv: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.
verses.modern: From Him the whole body, joined and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love as each part does its work.

verses.kjv: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
verses.modern: So I tell You this, and insist on it in the Lord, that You must no longer live as the Gentiles do, in the futility of their thinking.

verses.kjv: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:
verses.modern: They are darkened in their understanding and separated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them due to the hardening of their hearts.

verses.kjv: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
verses.modern: Having lost all sensitivity, they have given themselves over to sensuality so as to indulge in every kind of impurity, with a continual lust for more.

verses.kjv: But ye have not so learned Christ;
verses.modern: That is not the way of life You learned

verses.kjv: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
verses.modern: when You heard about Christ and were taught in Him in accordance with the truth that is in Jesus.

verses.kjv: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
verses.modern: You were taught, with regard to Your former way of life, to put off Your old self, which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires;

verses.kjv: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
verses.modern: to be made new in the attitude of Your minds;

verses.kjv: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
verses.modern: and that You put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.

verses.kjv: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
verses.modern: Therefore, each of You must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to Your neighbor, for we are all members of one body.

verses.kjv: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
verses.modern: "In Your anger do not sin": Do not let the sun go down while You are still angry,

verses.kjv: Neither give place to the devil.
verses.modern: and do not give the devil a foothold.

verses.kjv: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
verses.modern: Anyone who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing something useful with their own hands, so that they will have something to share with those in need.

verses.kjv: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
verses.modern: Do not let any unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building others up according to their needs, so that it may benefit those who listen.

verses.kjv: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
verses.modern: And do not grieve the Holy Ghost of God, with whom You were sealed for the day of redemption.

verses.kjv: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
verses.modern: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, brawling and slander, along with every form of malice.

verses.kjv: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
verses.modern: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave You.

chapters.summary: Paul urges believers to walk worthy of their calling with humility, gentleness, and longsuffering, endeavoring to keep the unity of the Spirit. He teaches that Christ gave apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers to build up the body until all come to the unity of the faith, and instructs them to put off the old man and put on the new man created in righteousness and true holiness.

verses.kjv: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
verses.modern: Follow God's example, therefore, as dearly loved children

verses.kjv: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
verses.modern: and walk in the way of love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant offering and sacrifice to God.

verses.kjv: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
verses.modern: But fornication and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be named among You, as is fitting for saints,

verses.kjv: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
verses.modern: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not fitting, but rather the giving of thanks.

verses.kjv: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
verses.modern: For this You know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

verses.kjv: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
verses.modern: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of such things God's wrath comes on those who are disobedient.

verses.kjv: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.
verses.modern: Therefore do not be partners with them.

verses.kjv: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
verses.modern: For You were once darkness, but now You are light in the Lord. Live as children of light

verses.kjv: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
verses.modern: (for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness, righteousness, and truth)

verses.kjv: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
verses.modern: and find out what pleases the Lord.

verses.kjv: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
verses.modern: Have nothing to do with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.

verses.kjv: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
verses.modern: It is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.

verses.kjv: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.
verses.modern: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible — and everything that is illuminated becomes a light.

verses.kjv: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
verses.modern: This is why it is said: "Wake up, sleeper, rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on You."

verses.kjv: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
verses.modern: Be very careful, then, how You live — not as unwise but as wise,

verses.kjv: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
verses.modern: making the most of every opportunity, because the days are evil.

verses.kjv: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
verses.modern: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord's will is.

verses.kjv: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
verses.modern: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless behavior. Instead, be filled with the Spirit,

verses.kjv: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
verses.modern: speaking to one another with psalms, hymns, and songs from the Spirit. Sing and make music from Your heart to the Lord,

verses.kjv: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.modern: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
verses.modern: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.

verses.kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
verses.modern: Wives, submit yourselves to Your own husbands as You do to the Lord.

verses.kjv: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
verses.modern: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, His body, of which He is the Savior.

verses.kjv: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
verses.modern: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.

verses.kjv: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
verses.modern: Husbands, love Your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her

verses.kjv: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
verses.modern: to make her holy, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word,

verses.kjv: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
verses.modern: and to present her to Himself as a radiant church, without stain or wrinkle or any other blemish, but holy and blameless.

verses.kjv: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.
verses.modern: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.

verses.kjv: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
verses.modern: After all, no one ever hated their own body, but they feed and care for their body, just as Christ does the church—

verses.kjv: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
verses.modern: For we are members of His body, of His flesh, and of His bones.

verses.kjv: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
verses.modern: "For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh."

verses.kjv: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
verses.modern: This is a profound mystery — but I am talking about Christ and the church.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.
verses.modern: However, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves Himself, and the wife must respect her husband.

chapters.summary: Paul instructs believers to walk in love as Christ loved us and gave Himself for us, to have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, and to walk circumspectly, redeeming the time. He teaches on marriage, declaring that husbands are to love their wives as Christ loved the church and gave Himself for it, and that this is a great mystery concerning Christ and the church.

verses.kjv: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
verses.modern: Children, obey Your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

verses.kjv: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)
verses.modern: "Honor Your father and mother" — which is the first commandment with a promise—

verses.kjv: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
verses.modern: "so that it may go well with You and that You may enjoy long life on the earth."

verses.kjv: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
verses.modern: Fathers, do not exasperate Your children; instead, bring them up in the training and instruction of the Lord.

verses.kjv: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
verses.modern: Servants, be obedient to those who are Your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in sincerity of heart, as to Christ,

verses.kjv: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
verses.modern: Obey not only when they are watching — as those who want to please men — but as slaves of Christ, doing the will of God from Your heart.

verses.kjv: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
verses.modern: Serve wholeheartedly, as if You were serving the Lord, not people,

verses.kjv: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
verses.modern: because You know that the Lord will reward each one for whatever good he does, whether he is slave or free.

verses.kjv: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
verses.modern: And, You masters, do the same things to them, giving up threatening, knowing that Your Master also is in heaven, and there is no respect of persons with Him.

verses.kjv: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
verses.modern: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the power of His might.

verses.kjv: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
verses.modern: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can take your stand against the devil's schemes.

verses.kjv: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
verses.modern: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.

verses.kjv: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
verses.modern: Therefore put on the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you may be able to stand your ground. After you have done everything, stand.

verses.kjv: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
verses.modern: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness,

verses.kjv: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
verses.modern: and with your feet fitted with the readiness that comes from the gospel of peace.

verses.kjv: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
verses.modern: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.

verses.kjv: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
verses.modern: Take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

verses.kjv: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
verses.modern: Pray in the Spirit on all occasions with all kinds of prayers and requests. With this in mind, be alert and always keep on praying for all the Lord's people.

verses.kjv: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
verses.modern: Pray also for me, that whenever I speak, words may be given me so that I will fearlessly make known the mystery of the gospel,

verses.kjv: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
verses.modern: for which I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may declare it fearlessly, as I should.

verses.kjv: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
verses.modern: Tychicus, the dear brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell You everything so You will know how I am and what I am doing.

verses.kjv: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
verses.modern: I am sending Him to You for this very purpose — that You may know how we are and that He may encourage You.

verses.kjv: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.modern: Peace to the brothers and sisters, and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
verses.modern: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.

chapters.summary: Paul instructs children to obey their parents, fathers not to provoke their children, servants to obey their masters as unto Christ, and masters to treat their servants justly. He commands believers to put on the whole armour of God — the belt of truth, breastplate of righteousness, shield of faith, helmet of salvation, and sword of the Spirit — to stand against the wiles of the devil.
